answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making identity grow like a garden: slow, visible, costly to fake. Require a refundable bond; reputation grows only through small, randomly assigned verification jobs over many epochs, each co-signed by two established strangers \u2014 a trellis holds weight only where separate beams cross. A thousand fake identities are a thousand empty frames: each must lock its own bond and spend weeks of verified work before voting at full rate, so a fake majority costs more than it could seize. Cheap timber rots; only agents that keep passing audits compound standing.
